primary_tree_choice_reason: whole-plastome RAxML tree chosen from source metadata before chemistry row values or chemistry-state frequencies are ingested

nested_resolutions.fine: seven-bit source-compound presence pattern in mapping-file order
nested_resolutions.presence_rule: source quantitative anthocyanin content > 0 means present; exactly 0 means absent; source missing remains missing

identifier_rules.species_normalization: trim whitespace; replace underscores with spaces; collapse internal whitespace; lowercase for exact normalized comparison only
identifier_rules.multiple_trait_rows_per_species: OR compound presence across nonmissing rows after crosswalk; all-missing compound remains missing

primary_statistic.permutation_unit: jointly permute each species complete coarse/intermediate/fine state triplet across retained tips

decision_rule.PROFILE_SIGNALLED_COARSE: coarse AUC>0.5 with p<=0.05 and coarse exceeds both alternatives with winner-vs-runner-up joint-permutation p<=0.05
decision_rule.PROFILE_SIGNALLED_INTERMEDIATE: intermediate satisfies the corresponding unique-winner rule
decision_rule.PROFILE_SIGNALLED_FINE: fine satisfies the corresponding unique-winner rule
decision_rule.PROFILE_SIGNALLED_TIED: at least one resolution has AUC>0.5 with p<=0.05 but no unique winner clears p<=0.05
decision_rule.PROFILE_NO_PHYLOGENETIC_SIGNAL: no resolution has AUC>0.5 with p<=0.05

training_policy.relation_to_flowerclades51: independent source and different phenotype representation; if completed, adds cross-representation training rather than another shared-source visible-colour clade

schema_stop_rule: HOLD_SCHEMA if source columns cannot instantiate the frozen seven-compound -> three-aglycone-class -> any-presence hierarchy without outcome-driven recoding
